title: Feeding a block to a doll stands in for early object pretense
summary: By about 30 months, CDC says most children pretend with objects, for example by offering a block to a doll as food.
body: Under learning and thinking at 30 months, CDC lists using things to pretend. The printed case is feeding a block to a doll as if the block were food. One toy stands in for another. The agency's most means at least three quarters of children, and the checklist is not a diagnosis. The block-and-doll scene is this page's illustration of substitution, from the US list only.
